title: Use of Aceclidine Ophthalmic Solution 1.44% (VIZZ TM) for Temporary Vision Improvement in Keratoconus
official: Use of Aceclidine Ophthalmic Solution 1.44% (VIZZ TM) for Temporary Vision Improvement in Keratoconus
summary: Primary objective: to evaluate whether once-daily aceclidine ophthalmic solution 1.44% (VIZZ TM) produces temporary improvement in visual function and optical quality in adults with keratoconus.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older, male or female
* Able to understand the study, provide written informed consent, and sign HIPAA authorization before study-specific procedures
* Willing and able to comply with study instructions, dosing, and follow-up visits
* Tomographic evidence of keratoconus on Pentacam imaging in at least one eye
* Investigator determines that at least one eye is suitable for the study assessments

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known hypersensitivity or sensitivity to aceclidine or any component of VIZZ
* Pregnancy or nursing
* Active ocular infection or inflammation, including active herpes simplex keratitis, herpes zoster keratitis, cornea melt, or active uveitis/iritis
* History of retinal tear or retinal detachment, or retinal disease that in the investigator's judgement makes miotic therapy inappropriate or would interfere with study assessments
* Posterior segment pathology or other ocular disease that may materially limit visual function or confound study outcomes, including clinically significant macular disease or glaucoma
* Any other ocular condition that, in the investigator's judgement, may predispose the subject to complications or interfere with reliable study measurements
* Use of an investigational drug or device within 30 days prior to enrollment or concurrent participation in another investigational trial
* Any medical or ocular reason for which the investigator believes participation would not be in the subject's best interest
